description: Dangerous Goods Incident Reports (DGIR) Incident - (PUBLIC Access) is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by Environmental Emergency. This dataset provides public access to Dangerous Goods Incident Report (DGIR) collected and managed by the Environmental Emergency Branch (EEB) of the Province of British Columbia. It includes information on reported hazardous material spills and incidents across the province. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher Environmental Emergency. Its tags are DGIR, Hazardous spills, Oil, Spill. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-08-04 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Access Only. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
